entries.name: Downstairs at The Dome
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Squarespace 'Events List' block on the venue's own /whatson page — server-rendered <article class="eventlist-event"> cards, each with a title link and a machine-readable <time class="event-date" datetime> — extracted by the new, small, generic ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ module (shared with Night Tales Loft/The Roxy, all three genuinely serve one of Squarespace's two documented event-block shapes). 101 real gig cards live-verified this package (POLIÇA, RATBOYS, WINE LIPS, A PLACE TO BURY STRANGERS, ...).
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 101 event cards live-fetched at proof time, overwhelmingly band/act names — MUSIC GATE: predominantly and reliably music-relevant.

research_provenance.note: Salvaged from the prior BEATMAPPED-LONDON-ALL-VENUE-RECOVERY-AND-FIRST-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 research (venue identity/address/coordinates), but re-verified live against current main and re-acquired via a new generic module (ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/) since main's own generic static-cards collector does not match this site's real markup.

entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 38 event cards live-fetched at proof time, entirely DJ/club-night bookings — MUSIC GATE: predominantly and reliably music-relevant.

research_provenance.note: Salvaged from the prior donor branch's research; re-verified live and re-acquired via ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ against current main.

entries.name: The Roxy
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Squarespace 'Summary Block' (event record type) on the venue's own /whatson page — server-rendered <div class="summary-item ... summary-item-record-type-event"> cards carrying a real data-title attribute and a genuine data-upcoming-event-end millisecond timestamp; extracted by the same ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ module's second block-shape path. 39 real club-night/live-music cards live-verified this package (ROXY TUESDAYS, NEON NIGHTS: LIVE MUSIC SHOWCASE + BATTLE JAM, ...). The venue's own page title is literally 'Live Music, Club Nights & Events London'.

entries.research_notes: 39 event cards live-fetched at proof time — MUSIC GATE: predominantly and reliably music-relevant (venue's own stated primary purpose is live music/club nights).
